name: Mountain Giant Muisek
summary: Northwest across Feralas, you face the last creatures Witch Doctor Uzer'i hopes to harness: mountain giants.

sections.title: Giants of the Rocky Ground
sections.body:
Witch Doctor Uzer'i says mountain giants came down from the mountains to aid the night elves when the Burning Legion first arrived in the world. Their immense size marks them, and rocky ground trembles beneath their steps. Uzer'i hopes to harness power on that scale.

Seven Land Walkers or Cliff Giants must fall. Then the Muisek Vessel can shrink and capture them.

sections.title: Uzer'i's Boast
sections.body: When you return, Witch Doctor Uzer'i speaks of what the gathered materials make possible. Uzer'i claims they can trap the creatures' spirits forever in whatever Uzer'i wishes.

faq.q: Who asks for the mountain giants' muisek?
faq.answer: Witch Doctor Uzer'i asks for the mountain giants' muisek. Uzer'i calls it your last request.

faq.q: Where are the mountain giants located?
faq.answer: Uzer'i sends you northwest across Feralas, where the mountain giants roam rocky terrain.
By Uzer'i's account, the mountain giants came down from the mountains to aid the night elves when the Burning Legion first arrived in the world.

faq.q: Which creatures provide the required muisek?
aliases: what do i kill for muisek
faq.answer: Land Walkers and Cliff Giants provide the muisek. Seven are needed, and the Muisek Vessel shrinks and captures each fallen giant.

faq.q: What comes before this in the sequence?
faq.answer: Treant Muisek comes before this, and Weapons of Spirit is listed after it.
